issue.title: test_load_config_ignores_retired_sdd_selectors fails under the full parallel lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Reproduction: just test-scoped (part of just check) failed this node under the full parallel lane while running tests/llm_provider/test_load_balanced_alias_defaults.py etc. for an unrelated change (restoring Gemini 3.7 Flash High to @xsmall only, plan restore_gemini_xsmall_only.md). Isolated rerun: .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_config.py::test_load_config_ignores_retired_sdd_selectors passes alone. This matches the known parallel-lane-only flake pattern (see closed retired-umbrella bead sase-ct and open node-specific bead sase-mv for the same mechanism on a different test node) rather than a defect in the Gemini/model-alias change under test. Scope: identify the shared/global state this test races on under xdist parallel execution and fix or isolate it.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired umbrella for the same class of full-parallel-lane-only ACE/config test flakes; do not +1 it.
RELATED: sase-mv — same mechanism (fails under full parallel lane, passes in isolation) on a different test node.

TRIAGE CLOSE (task-backlog triage, 2026-08-17, workspace sase_14 at HEAD 5feaabc71). Closing as already fixed by commit 3a22ff04f 'fix(config): isolate config cache from test-owned CONFIG_DIR' (epic sase-ns phase sase-ns.2, committed 2026-08-16T23:02:36Z).

EVIDENCE:
1. Mechanism match. tests/test_config.py:589 test_load_config_ignores_retired_sdd_selectors patches sase.config.core.CONFIG_DIR (line 596) — exactly the rebinding 3a22ff04f fixed by binding current_config_token() to the CONFIG_DIR object it was computed against, so rebinding that root becomes a cache-generation change instead of a silent stale-cache read.
2. Sibling nodes in the same file with the same CONFIG_DIR-patching shape were declared fixed by that same commit in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt: test_legacy_overlay_is_discovered_but_not_a_complete_owner, test_machine_overlays_require_matching_selector_and_keep_ordinary_overlays, test_selected_overlay_identity_cannot_be_overridden_by_other_sources.
3. Durable evidence is entirely pre-fix. ~/.sase/test-selection/gh_sase-org__sase holds 6 failure records for this node; the newest is 20260816T202039Z, which precedes the 2026-08-16T23:02:36Z fix. Across the 1,212 full-run records in the store there is no post-fix failure.
4. The node is not reported by 'just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake' at this HEAD (the gate lists 7 exceeding nodes; this is not one of them) and is not on the committed baseline.

If it recurs on a tree that contains 3a22ff04f, a +1 with post-close provenance reopens this bead automatically.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by 3a22ff04f; all failure evidence predates the fix.
